messages:
Lee: hi folks, accepted the GitHub invite but cloning private repo returns 404. I used my personal GH (lee-dev). Any way to fix without losing history?
Priya (IT): welcome! Quick check: did the invite go to lee@redwood.com or your personal email?
Lee: it went to my personal email lee.dev@gmail.com. I have a work account lee@redwood.com too but didn't realize invites go to email only.
Onboarding Bot: Invitation accepted by lee-dev at 2024-12-02 08:05 UTC. Added to team: rw-data (pending SSO).
Tom (eng): If the personal account accepted, it won't have org access unless we add it. Best practice is to use your work account. Priya can revoke and resend.
Priya (IT): we prefer invites to company accounts for audit reasons. Options: 1) we revoke the personal invite and send to lee@redwood.com, you accept there, add SSH key. 2) if you want to keep commits tied to personal GH, you can add your work email to that account as a secondary email, but that's not recommended. Which do you want?
Lee: go with revoking and resending to work email. I can enable 2FA now.
Priya (IT): cool. Enabling 2FA on the work account first is best. I'll revoke the current invite and send a new one.
Onboarding Bot: Admin action: Invite revoked for lee-dev at 2024-12-02 08:09 UTC. New invitation sent to lee@redwood.com at 2024-12-02 08:10 UTC.
Lee: accepted the work account invite and authorized SSO. I added my SSH key here.
Tom (eng): check you appear in https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/people with the rw-data team. Then try cloning via SSH.
Lee: confirmed team visible and clone works now. Thanks!
Priya (IT): I'll update onboarding checklist: "Accept invites on your company GitHub account, enable 2FA, add SSH key to work account; if you accepted with another account, contact IT to revoke and resend."
Lee: much appreciated.
